mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and increased consumer spending, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of decreasing industrial production (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 within the last month indicates a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of high inflation and tight monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the last month, it signals strong economic growth and a tightening labor market, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% in 3 months and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong GDP growth and falling unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
